semantic_unit.evidence_edges: set of exact (source_id, relation, target_id) triples
semantic_unit.rejected_evidence_spans: set derived from target_id of canonical rejects edges

canonicalization.allowed: remove only byte-identical repeated span IDs or field-identical repeated edge triples within one question
canonicalization.semantic_credit: a repeated member receives zero additional credit
forbidden_repairs: dropping a unique unknown or incorrect edge

hard_protocol_failures: missing, extra or conflicting question identity
invalid field type or normalized decision value
raw evidence array above its frozen size cap
reporting_rules: Always report semantic evidence quality and output conformance side by side.
Any duplicate makes the affected question nonconformant even when its canonical set is semantically correct.
Conformance failure does not erase independently valid factual or set-semantic measurements.
A complete Sentinel5 still requires all five prospective requests to be attempted and semantically scoreable.
Historical strict_unique_v1 results remain unchanged and cannot be merged with canonical_set_v2 runs.
Post-hoc replay is diagnostic only and cannot become an official benchmark score.

unchanged_primary_contract.note: This addendum changes output attribution, not dataset difficulty, gold answers or the frozen primary factual metric.
